lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  let w := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have h0 : 0 < w x₀ :=
    lt_of_ne_of_le (Ne.symm <| inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx₀) real_inner_self_nonneg'
  have hc : Continuous w := Continuous.inner' f _ hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hc.continuousAt.eventually (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds h0))
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨_, _, half_pos hδ0, half_lt_self hδ0⟩
  have key := hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ (contDiff_const (c := f x₀)))
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have c1 : Continuous (⇑φ * w) := φ.continuous.mul hc
  have c2 : HasCompactSupport (⇑φ * w) := φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right
  have c3 : 0 ≤ ⇑φ * w := fun x => if h : φ x = 0 then (mul_eq_zero_of_left h _).symm.le
    else mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hδ x (φ.support_eq ▸ h)).le
  have c4 : (⇑φ * w) x₀ ≠ 0 := (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0)) h0).ne'
  have c5 : 0 < ∫ x, (⇑φ * w) x ∂μ := c1.integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero c2 c3 c4
  exact ne_of_gt c5 key
